span: To show that specifically, "any one of the four families" is said because for those dwelling in the completion stage, there is no conceptualization. "Having taken" means having taken her as a companion in practice. "Possessing that realization" means attaining the deity's body through the completion stage. "That is **Vajradhara**" means because he has become the fruit of everything. "Completing that" means generating the meditative concentration of union. "Having completed it through the stages of manifest enlightenment" means through the two stages. This method is the cause for the accomplishment of the **Great Seal** <term>Mahāmudrā</term>. "When the red boundary is cut and passed" means at dusk, because at that time the sun sets. Therefore, at the time when night falls, the master dwelling in the center of the mandala should perform the ritual of the gathering-circle <term>gaṇacakra</term> with the five types of offerings and so forth, preceded by a prayer for the sake of attaining reality. Then, after the offerings, in the middle of the night, having received the empowerment of wisdom following the secret empowerment from the master who has become pure, one's own family is shown. One "receives empowerment through the arising of bliss." By that very taste, at the time when dawn breaks and the light appears, when the supreme driver of the sun appears, the parts of the night have passed. To show that, "at the time of the rising sun" means first the driver of the sun, the dawn, appears, and then the sun itself rises. At that time, through the instructions on the stages of manifest enlightenment, accomplishment will be attained.
old_translation:
experience the Clear Light—the three wisdoms of appearance and so forth arising from causes and conditions—through the sequence of the "manifest enlightenment" of the internal and external self. Having meditated on the Vajra Body of Union <term>yuganaddha</term>, which is the nature of the non-abiding nirvana arising from that, one should abide. To show that very point, the phrase "any one from the four families" is used because there is no conceptualization for one who abides in the completion stage. Regarding "having taken," this means having taken her as a companion in practice. 

Regarding "possessing that realization," this means obtaining the body of the deity through the completion stage. Regarding "**Vajradhara**," this is because he has become the fruit of all. "Perfecting that" means giving rise to the meditative concentration of union. Regarding "having perfected through the sequence of manifest enlightenment," this is through the two stages. Its method is the cause for the attainment of the Great Seal <term>Mahāmudrā</term>. 

Regarding "the red cord being cut and passing away," this refers to twilight, because at that time the sun sets. Therefore, at the time of nightfall, through the ritual of the feast-circle <term>gaṇacakra</term>, the Guru residing in the center of the mandala should be worshipped, preceded by a request for the sake of obtaining reality with the five types of offerings and so forth. Regarding "then" and so forth, after the worship, at the time of midnight, having received the "Wisdom" empowerment after the "Secret" one from the purified Guru, one's own family-awareness is shown. "Through the arising of bliss, the empowerment is received." 

At the very taste of that, when the night breaks and dawn rises—the time when the supreme driver of the sun rises—the parts of the night have passed. To show that very point, "at the autumn of the sun rising" means first the driver of the sun, the dawn, rises, and then the sun rises. At that time, one will obtain attainment through the oral instructions on the sequence of manifest enlightenment.
